model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the daily number of new patients and the daily number of confirmed COVID-19 cases over time. The horizontal axis represents dates, ranging from July 31, 2022, to August 26, 2022, with each date labeled individually. The vertical axis represents the number of cases, labeled "每日新增患者人数" and "每周媒体报道数日变化趋势," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 180,000, and tick labels at intervals of 200,000. The chart displays a series of green bars, each representing the daily number of new patients. The shortest bar, corresponding to August 12, 2022, has an approximate value of 80,000, while the tallest bar, corresponding to August 5, 2022, has an approximate value of 160,000. The bars are arranged chronologically, and no bars are visually emphasized.
